# Real-time delivery tracker

*Client industry: logistics | Completed: 2025-04-18 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p03*

## The problem
The client was a courier startup fielding 'where is my parcel' calls.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using React, a JavaScript backend, live updates pushed to the browser, Redis. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project halved support calls in the first month.
